_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Devarim 13, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And all the commandment which I command you — keep it and do it; you shall not add to it anything, nor diminish from it.
translations.2: And if there arise among you a claimant of prophecy, or one who dreams a dream, and he gives you a sign or a proof,
translations.3: and the sign or the proof should come to pass as he said to you: 'Come, let us go to other objects of worship which you have not known, that we may serve them' —
translations.4: do not accept from that claimant of prophecy, or that dreamer of dreams; for God your Lord is testing you, to make manifest whether you love Him and are devoted, with all your hearts and your souls.
translations.5: Rather, in the footsteps of God your Lord shall you walk; and Him alone hold in awe; and His commandments keep; and His decree accept; and Him alone serve; and to His obedience cleave.
translations.6: And that claimant of prophecy or dreamer of dreams shall be put to death — for he speaks an impossible thing against God your Lord, who brought you out from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of bondage — to thrust you away from the path which God your Lord commanded you to walk; and purge the people of evil from your midst.
translations.7: And if your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter, or your wife who is your bond, or your companion who is as your own soul, should incite you in secret, saying: 'Come, let us serve other objects of worship which you have not known — you and your fathers —'
translations.8: from among the objects of worship of the nations that are around you, the nearest to you or the farthest from you, from one end of the earth to the other —
translations.9: do not consent to that, and do not accept it from him, and do not show compassion toward him, and do not take pity on him, and do not conceal it on his behalf.
translations.10: Rather, slay him with slaying; and your hand shall be the first to fall upon him to kill him, and the hand of the rest of the nation last.
translations.11: And stone him with stones until he dies — for he sought to thrust you away from God your Lord, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translations.12: And the rest of the house of Israel shall hear and be afraid, and shall not repeat doing the like of this evil thing in your midst.
translations.13: And if you should hear, concerning one of your towns which God your Lord is giving you to dwell in, the saying of one who says:
translations.14: 'There have gone out a band of unbelieving men from it, and they have led astray the people of their town, saying: Come, let us serve other objects of worship which you have not known' —
translations.15: then seek it out and investigate it, and inquire concerning it thoroughly; and if the matter be true and confirmed, that this abomination has been done in your midst,
translations.16: slay with slaying the people of that town by the edge of the sword; and destroy it and all that is in it, even its beasts, by the edge of the sword.
translations.17: And all its spoil — gather it to the center of its square, and burn with fire that town and all its spoil, as a whole offering to God your Lord; and it shall be a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt.
translations.18: And let nothing of the destroyed thing cling to your hand — so that God may turn back from the intensity of His anger, and give you His mercy and have mercy on you and multiply you, as He swore to your fathers —
translations.19: when you accept the command of God your Lord, and keep and do all His commandments which I command you today, doing what is upright in His sight.
